Extension · Figures and tables

Figure Lab

Adds figure, subfigure, and TikZ helpers for papers that depend on diagrams and visual results.

What it adds

  • draw.io and image to TikZ converter
  • Open the TikZ converter for new figures
  • Unreferenced figures
  • Snippet: Two-panel figure
  • Snippet: PGFPlots figure

Tags

  • figures
  • tikz
  • graphics

Details

  • Version 1.0.0
  • By LatexDo
  • Identifier latexdo.figure-lab

Install Figure Lab

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Figure Lab and choose Install. It is free.
